% Pattern: structure/head. The body of the paper, in body.tex, has CRLF line
% ends, so a blank line is \r\n\r\n, and each head command after it still
% starts a paragraph: the three items are found. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want head-1 statement/lemma 1.1
% want head-2 statement/claim 1.2
% want head-3 statement/lemma 1.3
\documentclass{article}
\newcounter{Mycounter}[section]
\newcounter{lemma}[section]
\renewcommand{\thelemma}{{Lemma \thesection.\arabic{lemma}}}
\newcommand{\lemma}{%
    \setcounter{lemma}{\value{Mycounter}}
    \refstepcounter{lemma}
    \stepcounter{Mycounter}
    {\noindent \bf \thelemma:\ }}
\newcounter{claim}[section]
\renewcommand{\theclaim}{{Claim \thesection.\arabic{claim}}}
\newcommand{\claim}{%
    \setcounter{claim}{\value{Mycounter}}
    \refstepcounter{claim}
    \stepcounter{Mycounter}
    {\noindent \bf \theclaim:\ }}
\begin{document}
\input{body}
\end{document}
